title: The Eroded Archive Platform

features.name: salt-worn platform edge
features.desc-on-touch: The platform's rim shows its work—each salt cycle has taken something, left something. The stone holds the memory of what it has surrendered. You can read the years as layers of forgetting.

features.name: the archive's foundation, half-gone
features.desc-on-touch: What remains of the original node housing, now mostly salt-ghost. The casing has become the landscape. The corruption has won beautifully here.

features.name: tidal pool memory
features.desc-on-touch: In the depression where salt pools gather, the archive dreams of freshwater. Files surface here that speak only at high tide.

features.name: survey marker, unmade
features.desc-on-touch: Stone carved with coordinates that no longer locate anything. The salt has taught the marker to forget its own purpose. Direction here is negotiable.

inscription: the archive did not rot; it learned to become stone

file.name: Cape_Survey_1987_Coordinates_Still_Valid.txt
file.note: GPS readings from the final working platform, each one slightly more wrong than the last as salt corrupted the antenna
